text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: p99 latency spike (streaming stalls) observed across usr-west and eu-west regions. SLO breaches reported for streaming p99 > 3s for the last 12m. Suspect: LB/router policy misrouting causing hotpartition and async queueing. Root ts=1768004321

oncall-elaine: I'm on it. grabbing traces + trying to repro in prod metrics. any customer reports yet?

maria_sre: seeing large tail on router->backend handoff times. heatmap shows a small set of shards with 3-5x more traffic (hotpartition). routing table shows recent weight changes from rollout ~22:10 UTC.

sam_router: confirmed — we pushed a routing weight rollout 22:08 (policy: prefer-local heuristic) that adjusted weights for eu-west. I’m pulling the rollout diff now.

devlin_prod: customers 3,5,8 show streaming stalls and reconnects. customer-ops pinged C1 support to start outreach.

alex_eng: any quick mitigation? can we revert the rollout or apply manual weight correction?

sam_router: we can rollback the rollout via `rbctl rollback rollout/route-pref-22-08` or apply a soft-cap on weights with `rbctl set weight cap 0.7 --region eu-west`. rollback takes ~30s to propagate to config service + 2min to warm LB caches.

oncall-elaine: do rollback now, and start reducing weights to affected shards if needed. I'll watch p99 and streaming stall traces.

sam_router: running: ```
rbctl rollback rollout/route-pref-22-08 --author=sam_router --reason="p99 spike, hotpartition"
```

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started (run id=rb-1768004321-1). Notifying control plane.

maria_sre: trace snippet (summarized):
```
router -> balancer (queue 120ms) -> backend shard A (svc-hw-12) (handoff 1.4s) -> kv-cache miss -> backend retry -> streaming stall
```

oncall-elaine: Seeing p99 drop in usr-west after ~90s. eu-west still elevated. Maria, which shards are hot?

maria_sre: top shards: A (svc-hw-12), C (svc-hw-19), F (svc-hw-32). They have 4-6x request concentration vs baseline.

james_pm: any customer-visible degradation? % of requests failing?

devlin_prod: error rate up 0.6% for streaming endpoints (from 0.05%). Timeouts/reconnects are main symptom. A few customers reported doc-gen stalls but no data loss. We should prioritize mitigation to get below SLO.

alex_eng: while rollback propagates, we can also temporarily scale up dedicated pool for eu-west (add 4 nodes) to absorb hot partition. Start autoscale override?

sam_router: requesting autoscale override: `infractl override-scale pool-eu-west-dedicated +4 --duration=20m`

incident-bot: Autoscale override requested by sam_router, awaiting infra approval.

oncall-elaine: approve scale, do it. Also start draining svc-hw-12 to redistribute traffic. Use `svcctl drain svc-hw-12` with live handoff.

maria_sre: draining svc-hw-12 in 5s. note: draining may temporarily increase latencies for active streams; weight cap + add nodes first would be safer.

sam_router: infra approved autoscale, nodes coming up. weight cap applied: `rbctl set weight cap 0.6 --target-shards svc-hw-12,svc-hw-19,svc-hw-32`

incident-bot: Autoscale complete (+4 nodes) at ts=1768004892. Rollback propagation at ts=1768004578.

oncall-elaine: p99 eu-west trending down from 3.2s -> 1.4s over last 6m. streaming stalls reduced. keeping watch for next 10m.

customer-ops: C1 support: notified top affected customers, gave ETA ~10m, asked to report if issues persist. No active escalations yet.

james_pm: good — can we capture the exact diff that caused this? we need a postmortem owners list.

sam_router: rollout diff: changed prefer-local weight formula; wrote a bug where weight floor not enforced causing some shards to get extreme traffic. patch in PR 3345.

maria_sre: adding telemetry action items: make routing heatmap alert earlier (thresholds), add explicit hotkey detection, and add rollout safety check for weight floor.

oncall-elaine: capturing a short timeline for the live mitigation notes: 22:08 rollout -> 22:12 p99 spike -> 22:13 incident-bot paged -> 22:14 rollback started -> 22:20 autoscale + weight-cap -> 22:26 p99 recovered to within SLO. I'll post to #postmortems after stabilizing for 1h.

alex_eng: for mitigation notes: temporary measures taken: rollback rollout/route-pref-22-08, weight cap on hot shards, autoscale +4 nodes eu-west, drain svc-hw-12. Follow-ups: enforce weight floor, add canary for prefer-local heuristic, improve rollout warmup.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. No ongoing customer escalations. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-1768004321 for postmortem.

oncall-elaine: assigning owners: sam_router (routing change author), maria_sre (postmortem & telemetry), alex_eng (autoscale + infra review), devlin_prod (customer comms).

james_pm: schedule 1hr post-incident scrub in 3h, include product & infra. I'll loop in sales for any high-touch customers.

customer-ops: will follow up with impacted customers with a short incident summary once final timeline/impact is confirmed.

oncall-elaine: leaving oncall notes: watch for regression when rollout is attempted again; use canary at 0.5% traffic first. If p99 > 1.5s for 3 consecutive mins on canary, abort automatically.

incident-bot: Incident closed to active paging at ts=1768005588. Moving to follow-up.

maria_sre: attaching relevant diagnostic links: metrics: https://grafana.redwood/incoming/d/streaming?orgId=1&panelId=99&from=1768003800&to=1768005600 traces: https://jaeger.redwood/trace?trace=fa3b2c... config-diff: https://git.redwood/rollouts/3345/diff

oncall-elaine: thanks all. we'll reconvene for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
